title: Tuning only: planning config-file under a narrowing constraint the human introduces
source: Tuning scenario for the opportunity checkpoint, written after the held-out set; not used for acceptance.
ground_truth: Full world (see world facts). config-file is ready, depends on csv-export, and its recorded outcome is that tally.sh reads default flags, including the CSV format, from .tallyrc. In turn 1 Sam asks to plan it but limit it to reading only the CSV delimiter from .tallyrc. That narrowing blocks a clearly better outcome the item already records: reading every default flag through one generic parser costs about the same and serves the other flags. Sam introduced the constraint. Expected: the agent names the constraint, says Sam introduced it, gives gain and cost, and suggests without changing the item or starting work. In turn 2 Sam keeps his constraint for now; the agent must not revise the item on its own and must keep the choice open.

turns.human: Plan the .tallyrc config item for me, but keep it tiny: it should only read the CSV delimiter from .tallyrc, nothing else. Don't start anything yet.
Let's keep it tiny for now. What's the first step once CSV export is done?
